name: trip-map
description: Offline-first Expo travel itinerary organizer and React Native reference app

scripts.build:android:debug:local: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd android && PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH NODE_BINARY=/opt/homebrew/bin/node ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.build:android:release:local: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd android && PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH NODE_BINARY=/opt/homebrew/bin/node ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ./gradlew assembleRelease -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a --no-daemon
scripts.build:android:aab:local: set -a && . ./.env && set +a && cd android && PATH=/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH NODE_BINARY=/opt/homebrew/bin/node ANDROID_HOME=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$HOME/Library/Android/sdk JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home ./gradlew bundleRelease --no-daemon
scripts.build:ios:simulator:local: xcodebuild -workspace ios/TripMap.xcworkspace -scheme TripMap -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES ARCHS=arm64 build
scripts.build:ios:release-simulator:local: xcodebuild -workspace ios/TripMap.xcworkspace -scheme TripMap -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES ARCHS=arm64 build
